overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: only 12 of the council's 54 members attended, below the 28-member quorum, so no meeting occurred. The AG declined to rule on the validity of the actions taken.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the council held a September 19, 2012 meeting without a quorum of its members.
allegations.key_passage: Because only 12 members participated in the September 19, 2012 meeting, the Council did not deliberate and did not hold a "meeting" for the purposes of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant asked that actions taken at the sub-quorum meeting be rescinded and reconsidered at a new meeting with a quorum present.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review the validity or legality of any action taken by a sub-quorum of the Council on September 19, 2012.
